w m'mwr shdhm nkhstyn ks~ [dr yn mt] bshm kh tslym [mHD dr mqbl prwrdgr] st>>.
bgw: <<gr dr brbr prwrdgrm nfrmn bshm, z `dhb rwz bzrg [qymt] m~trsm>>.
[y pymbr] bgw: <<mn llh r b khlwSi `tqd khwd `bdt mykhnm;
shm nyz Gyr z llh, hr chh r mykhwhyd `bdt khnyd>>. bgw: <<zynkrn [wq`~] ksn~ hstnd kh [bh Tm` dny] khwd w khnwdhhyshn r dr rstkhyz bh zyn ndkhtnd. agh bshyd kh yn, hmn zyn ashkhr st.
br bly sr w zyr pyshn Tbqt~ z atsh st. yn st anchh llh bndgnsh r z an m~trsnd. ~ bndgn mn, z [nfrmn~] mn prw knyd.
bshrt br~ ksn~ st kh z `bdt TGwt [= m`bwdn Gyr llh] jtnb wrzydnd w [twbhkhnn] bh drgh lhy bzgshtnd; ps [y pymbr,] [bhsht r] bh bndgnm bshrt bdh.
[hmn] khsny khh skhn[hy mkhtlf] r myshnwnd w z bhtryn an pyrw~ m~knnd. ann ksn~ hstnd kh llh hdytshn khrdh w khrdmndnd.
ay ks~ r kh frmn mjzt br w qT`y shdh st [mytwn hdyt nmwd]? ay tw m~twn~ khsy r kh dr atsh st, njt dhy?
m ksn~ kh z [`dhb] prwrdgrshn prw drnd, bry ann [dr bhsht] Grfhhyy st khh br frz anh Grfhhy dygry skhth shdh [w] jwybrh z zyr anh jry st. yn w`dh r llh ddh st w llh dr w`dh khlf nmykhnd.

ay ndydhy kh llh brn~ z asmn frstd w an r [bh Swrt] chshmhhy~ dr zmyn jry skht; angh bh wsylhy an, kshtzr~ b rnghy gwngwn pdyd m~awrd; sps pjmrdh m~grdd w m~byn~ kh zrd shdh st; angh an r khurd w khshkh m~szd? bytrdyd, dr yn [dgrgwnyh] pndy br~ khrdmndn st.
ps ay ks~ kh llh dlsh r pdhyr~ slm krdh w z jnb prwrdgrsh, z nwr [hdyt w bSyrt] brkhwrdr gshth, [hmnnd skhtdln st]? w~ br ann khh dr brbri dhkr llh sngdl shdhnd! ann dr gmrh~i ashkrnd.

llh bhtryn skhn r bh Swrt ktb~ nzl krdh kh [brkhy z aytsh] hmnnd ykdygr w [brkhy nyz] mkhrr st. ksn~ kh z [mjzt] prwrdgrshn bym drnd, [b shnydn yn ayt,] mw br tnshn rst myshwd w sps dl w jnshn b yd llh arm mygyrd. yn hdyti llh st kh hr khs r bkhwhd, bh an rh mynmyd; w hr khs khh llh w r gmrh szd, hych hdytgry nkhwhd dsht.
ps ay ksy kh dr rwz qymt [dstnsh bsth st w nchr] b Swrtsh an `dhb skht r df` m~knd, [hmchwn khsy st khh dr asysh bhsht qrr drd]? bh stmkhrn [mshrkh] gfth myshwd: <<[ntyjhy] dstwrdtn r bchshyd>>.
khsny khh pysh z ann bwdnd [nyz ayt llh r] drwG shmrdnd w z jy~ kh gmn nm~krdnd, `dhb dmngyrshn shd.
llh [T`m] rswyy w khwry r dr zndgy dny bh ann chshnd; w mslWman `dhb akhrt bzrgtr [w skhttr] st. gr mshrkhn mydnstnd [khh rftrshn chh pymdy drd, `brt mygrftnd].
dr yn qran, z hr [gwnh] mathl~ br~ mrdm awrdhym; bshd khh pnd pdhyrnd.
qran~ bh zbn fSyH `rby w bdwn hych gwnh bhm w nHrf [nzl krdym]; bshd khh [tHt t`lymtsh, z prwrdgr ykht] prw khnnd.

llh [br~ mqyshy mshrkh w mwHd,] mrd~ r mthl myznd kh chnd shrykh drbrhy [mlkhyti] w pywsth b hm khtlf w mshjrh drnd; w dr mqbl an, mrd~ kh tHt frmn ykh nfr qrr drd. ay yn dw nfr, [z nZri mwq`yt] yksnnd? stysh mkhSwS llh st; wl~ byshtr ann nm~dnnd.
[y pymbr,] qT`an tw khwhy murd w ann [nyz] khwhnd murd.
angh [shm mrdm] dr rwz qymt, nzd prwrdgrtn [drbrhy msyl mwrd khtlf,] mjdlh khwhyd khrd.
w kyst stmkrtr z khsy kh bh llh, drwG nsbt mydhd w skhn rsty r kh bh wy rsydh st, drwG myshmrd? ay dr dwzkh, jygh~ br~ khfrn nyst?
m khsny khh pym rstyn bywrnd [w dygrn r bh pdhyrsh an d`wt khnnd] w khwd nyz an r tSdyq nmynd, bh rsty prhyzgrnd.
hr chh bkhwhnd, nzd prwrdgrshn drnd. pdsh nykwkrn hmyn st.
t llh, bdtryn rftrshn r z [krnmhy] ann bzdyd w br ss bhtryn `mlshn, bh ann pdsh dhd.
ay llh br~ df` z bndhsh kf~ nyst? m [mshrkhn] tw r z m`bwdn[bTl]shn m~trsnnd; w hr khs kh llh w r gmrh khnd, hych hdytgry nkhwhd dsht.
w hr khs khh llh w r hdyt khnd, hych khs w r gmrh nkhwhd skht. ay llh shkhstnpdhyr w ntqmgyrndh nyst?

[y pymbr,] gr z mshrkhn bprsy: <<chh khsy asmnh w zmyn r afrydh st?>>, mslman mygwynd: <<llh>>. bh ann bgw: <<ps bh nZr shm, gr llh nkhwshy w rnjy brym bkhwhd, ay anchh bh j~ llh [bh nyysh] m~khwnyd, mytwnnd asyb w r brTrf khnnd? y gr llh rHmt~ br~ mn bkhwhd, ay m~twnnd mn` w shwnd?>> bgw: [pshtybnyi] llh brym khfy st. hl twkhl, tnh br w twkl m~knnd>>.
bgw: <<~ qwm mn, shm br rwsh khwd `ml khnyd, mn nyz [bh wZyf khwd] `ml m~knm.
bh zwd~ khwhyd dnst kh kyst ankh [dr dny] grftri `dhb rswgr myshwd w [dr akhrt,] `dhb pyndh br srsh mybrd>>.
yn ktb asmny r br~ [hdyt] mrdm, bhHq br tw nzl krdym; hr khs hdyt shwd, bh swdi khwd wst w hr khs gmrh gsht, bh zyn khwysh gmrh shdh st; w tw [nghbn w] khrszshn nyst~ [khh ann r bh hdyt jbr khny].

llh jnh r dr lHZhy mrg m~gyrd w [nyz] jn khsy r kh nmrdh st, bh hngm khwbsh [m~gyrd]; angh jnhyy r kh Hkm mrg br anh rndh st, ngh m~drd w jni dygrn r t hngm m`yn [mrg] bzps myfrstd. dr yn [mr] br~ hr khs khh byndyshd, nshnhhy~ [z qymt] wjwd drd.
ay mshrkhn Gyr z llh, shfy`ny [bry khwd z myn m`bwdn bTlshn] ntkhb khrdhnd? [y pymbr, bh ann] bgw: <<Hty gr anh mlkh chyzy nbshnd w [chyzy r] drkh nkhnnd [bz hm anh r bh shf`t myTlbyd]?>>
bgw: <<tmm shf`th, fqT z ani llh st. frmnrwyy asmnh w zmyn [nyz] z an wst; sps [dr rwz qymt, hmgy] bh pyshghi w bzgrdndh myshwyd>>.
hngmy khh llh bh ykhtyy [w twHyd] yd myshwd, dlhy khsny khh bh akhrt ymn ndrnd, mtnfr [w byzr] mygrdd; w chwn z m`bwdny Gyr z llh yd shwd, angh st khh mshrkhn shdmn mygrdnd.
bgw: <<br lh, [y] afrynndhy asmnh w zmyn, y dny nhn w ashkhr, tw [bh tnhyy] myn bndgnt rj` bh anchh [dr dny] dr an khtlf mywrzydnd dwry khwhy khrd>>.
gr dw brbr anchh dr zmyn st, dr khtyr stmkhrn [mshrkh] bshd, hmh r br~ njt khwd z skht~i `dhbi rwz qymt fd m~knnd; [wl~ pdhyrftn~ nyst]; w mwry z jnb llh bryshn ashkr m~grdd kh tSwrsh r hm nm~krdnd.
[dr an rwz,] dstwrd zshtshn br ann ashkr m~shwd w `dhb~ kh mskhrh m~krdnd, dmngyrshn khwhd shd.

hr gh nsn dchr [rnj w] zyny shwd, m r [bh nyysh] m~khwnd; w chwn z jnb khwysh n`mt~ bh wy rzn~ drym, mygwyd: <<fqT [lyqt w] dnyyi khwdm mwjb yn n`mt shdh st. [nh,] blkh yn azmysh [lhy] st; wl~ byshtr mrdm nm~dnnd.
pyshynyn ann nyz hmyn skhn r gftnd; wl~ [bh hngm `dhb,] dstwrdshn swd~ bh Hlshn ndsht.
w [`qwbt] dstwrd zsht ann dmngyrshn shd. yn stmkhrn [mshrkh] nyz bh `qwbt dstwrdshn grftr khwhnd shd w [prwrdgr mt`l r] bh tng nkhwhnd awrd.
ay mshrkhn nmydnnd khh llh [n`mt w] rwzy r br hr khs khh bkhwhd, gstrdh mydrd w y tng mygrdnd? bygmn dr yn mr, nshnhhyy [z tdbyr w Hkhmt lhy] bry mwmnn st.
[y pymbr,] bh bndgnm khh [dr rtkhb bh shrkh w gnh] zydhrwy khrdhnd, bgw: <<z rHmt lhy m'yws nbshyd; chr khh [gr twbh khnyd,] llh hmhy gnhntn r mybkhshd. bh rsty khh w t`ly bsyr amrzndh w mhrbn st.
pysh z ankhh `dhb bh srGtn byyd w hych khs ntwnd yrytn khnd, bh swy prwrdgrtn bzgrdyd w tslym [frmni] w shwyd.
w pysh z ankh nghn dr Hly khh Gflyd `dhb bh srGtn byyd, z bhtryn dstwrhy~ kh z jnb prwrdgrtn br shm nzl shdh st, pyrw~ khnyd.
[hmkhnwn br Hdhr bshyd] t khsy [dr rwz qymt] ngwyd: <<y dryG br mn khh dr Hqi llh khwthy nmwdm w [mw'mnn r] mskhrh mykhrdm!>>
y [gnh khwd r br grdn tqdyr nyndzd w] ngwyd: <<gr llh mr hdyt khrdh bwd, qT`an prhyzgr bwdm>>
y hngmy khh `dhb r mybynd, ngwyd: <<y khsh bzgshty [bh dny] dshtm t dr zmrhy nykhwkhrn qrr mygrftm>>.
[llh myfrmyd:] <<ary, ayt mn bryt amd w tw anh r drwG pndshty w tkhbr nmwdy w khfr wrzydy>>.
w rwz qymt khsny r khh br llh drwG bsthnd, syhrwy mybyny. ay dr dwzkh jyghy bry mtkhbrn nyst?
llh, prhyzgrn r b drawrdn bh mkhn khmybyshn, [z `dhb] njt mydhd. [dr bhsht,] nh rnjy bh ann myrsd w nh ndwhgyn myshwnd.
llh afrydgr hr chyzy st w w t`ly br hmh chyz [nghbn w] khrsz st.
khlyd gnjynhhy asmnh w zmyn z ani wst; w khsny khh bh ayt lhy khfr shdnd, qT`an zynkhrnd.
[y pymbr,] bgw: <<y bykhbrn, ay bh mn frmn mydhyd khh [m`bwdy] Gyr z llh r `bdt khnm?>>
bh tw w pymbrni pysh z tw wH~ shdh st kh: <<gr shrkh bwrz~, [pdshi] khrhyt qT`an br bd khwhd rft w zynkr khwh~ shd;
blkhh tnh llh r `bdt khn w spsgzr bsh>>.
mshrkhn, llh r chnn kh szwr wst, rj nnhdnd; Hl ankhh dr rwz qymt, zmyn yksrh dr qbDhy wst; w asmnh bh dst wy drhmpychydh khwhd shd. pkh w mnzh st llh; w z chyzhyy khh b [wy] shrykh mysznd, brtr st.

[dr astnhy qymt,] dr <<Swr>> dmydh myshwd; angh hr khs khh dr asmnh w dr zmyn st, mdhwshi mrg khwhd shd mgr ks~ kh llh bkhwhd; angh br dygr dr an dmydh myshwd w nghn [hmh z mrg] brmykhyznd w chshmbhrh [frmn prwrdgr] hstnd.
[dr rwz qymt,] zmyn bh nwri prwrdgrsh rwshn khwhd shd w nmhy [`ml] nhdh myshwd w pymbrn w gwhn r myawrnd w bh Hq w `dlt myn mrdm dwry myshwd w hrgz bh ann stm nkhwhd shd.

khfrn grwhgrwh bh sw~ dwzkh rndh m~shwnd. hmyn kh bh anj myrsnd, drhysh [bh rwy ann] gshwdh mygrdd w nghbnnsh mygwynd: <<ay pymbrny z myn khwd shm bh srGtn nymdnd kh ayt prwrdgrtn r bry shm m~khwndnd w drbrhy dydr yn rwz hshdr m~ddnd?>> ann [dr pskh] m~gwynd: <<ary; wl~ [m ann r nkhr krdym w] frmn mjzt, sz~ khfrn st>>.
[bh ann] gfth m~shwd: <<z drh~ dwzkh wrd shwyd w jwdnh dr an bh sr baryd; w [bh rst~] jygh mtkbrn, chh bd [jygh~] st!>>

w ksn~ kh z prwrdgrshn prw dshtnd, grwhgrwh bh sw~ bhsht hdyt m~shwnd; hmyn kh bh anj myrsnd dr Hly kh drh~ bhsht gshwdh shdh st [b `zt w Htrm wrd myshwnd] w nghbnn anj mygwynd: <<slm br shm. khwsh amdyd. [w] bry hmyshh [dr an bmnyd]>>.

bhshtyn m~gwynd: <<stysh w sps mkhSwS llh st kh w`dhy khwysh r dr mwrd m tHqq bkhshyd w srzmyn [phnwr bhsht] r bh m myrth dd kh dr hr j~ an bkhwhym, mnzl mygyrym; w [bh rst~] pdsh hl `ml, chh nykwst!>>
[dr an rwz,] frshtgn r khwhy dyd kh pyrmwn `rsh Hlqh zdhnd w prwrdgrshn r bh pkhy mystynd; w bh Hq w `dlt myn mrdm dwr~ khwhd shd w gfth m~shwd: <<stysh w sps, mkhSwS llh - prwrdgr jhnyn- st>>.
Hm [H. mym]
nzwl [yn] khtb, z swy llh shkhstnpdhyri dnst.
[prwrdgry khh] amrzndhy gnh w twbhpdhyr, skhtkhyfr w n`mtbkhsh st; hych m`bwdy [bhHq] jz w nyst w bzgsht [hmh] bh swy wst.
tnh khfrn hstnd khh drbrhy ayt lhy mjdlh m~knnd; ps mbd rft w amdshn dr shhrh [bry tjrt w bhrhmndyshn z n`mthy dny] tw r bfrybd.

pysh z ann qwm nwH, w ps z ann nyz grwhhy dygry [hmchwn qwm `d w thmwd w lwT nyz pymbrnshn r] drwGgw shmrdnd w hr qwmy khwst pymbrsh r dstgyr knd [w bh qtl brsnd]. ann bh bTl mjdlh krdnd t bh wsylh an, Hq r z myn brdrnd; mn nyz ann r `dhb khrdm; [ps bngryd khh] `dhbi mn chgwnh bwd.
w frmn `dhbi prwrdgrt drbrh khfrn ynchnyn bh tHqq pywst kh ann hl atshnd.

frshtgn~ kh `rsh r Hml m~knnd w frshtgn~ kh grdi an Hlqh zdhnd, prwrdgrshn r bh pkhy mystynd w bh w ymn drnd w [yn gwnh] br~ hl ymn amrzsh m~khwhnd: <<prwrdgr, rHmt w dnsht, hr chyz~ r frgrfth st; ps ksn~ r kh twbh krdnd w pyrw rh tw shdnd, bymrz w z `dhb dwzkh dwr ngh dr>>.
prwrdgr, ann w pdrn [w mdrn] w hmsrn w frzndn SlHshn r dr bGhy jwdn bhsht kh w`dh ddh~, dkhl kn, kh bytrdyd, tw shkhstnpdhyr w Hkhymy.
[br lh,] ann r z [kyfri] bdyh HfZ kn; w qT`an hr khs r khh dr an rwz z [kyfri] bdyh ngh dr~, mshmwl rHmtt qrr ddh~. yn, hmn kmyb~ bzrg st>>.
[dr dwzkh] bh khfrn nd m~dhnd kh: <<dshmn~ w khshm llh, skhttr z dshmn~ w khshm shm nsbt bh khwdtn st; chr kh bh ymn d`wt m~shdyd, wl~ [b dshmn~ nsbt bh khwd, `qydhy twHydy r] nkr m~krdyd>>.
ann [dr pskh] mygwynd: <<prwrdgr, m r dwbr myrndy w dw br zndh khrdy; ps [khnwn khh] bh gnhn khwd `trf khrdym, ay rhy bry khrwj [z dwzkh] wjwd drd?>>
[bh ann gfth myshwd:] <<yn [`dhb] bh sbb an st khh chwn llh bh ygngy khwndh myshd, nkhr mykhrdyd; wly gr bh w shrkh awrdh myshd ymn myawrdyd. [khnwn] dwry z an llh blndmrtbhy bzrg st.
w hmn dhty st khh nshnhhy [twn w tdbyr] khwd r bh shm ry'h mydhd w [b nzwl brn] z asmn rwz~ brytn m~frstd; wl~ tnh ksn~ pnd m~gyrnd kh [khlSnh bh drgh lhy] twbh khnnd.
[y mrdm! tnh] llh r b khlwSi `tqd bkhwnyd; hr chnd khfrn khwshshn nyyd.
w dry drjt rfy` w SHbi `rsh st; w bh swy hr ykh z bndgnsh kh bkhwhd, bh frmn khwysh wH~ m~frstd t drbrhy rwz mlqt [bh ann] hshdr dhd.
rwzy kh mrdm HDr w nmyn myshwnd w chyzy z ann br llh pwshydh nkhwhd mnd, [llh myfrmyd:] <<mrwz frmnrwyy z ani khyst?>> [angh khwd myfrmyd:] <<z ani llh ygnh pyrwzmnd>>.
mrwz hr khs dr brbr anchh khrdh st, pdsh ddh myshwd w hych stmy dr myn nyst. bygmn, llh dr Hsbrsy sry` st.

dr mwrd rwz qymt [khh bsyr nzdykh st] bh ann hshdr bdh; angh kh jnh [z shdt wHsht] bh glwgh m~rsd, dr Hl~ kh srshr z ndwh shdhnd. [dr an rwz,] stmgrn nh dwst~ mhrbn drnd w nh shfy`y kh skhnsh pdhyrfth shwd.
[llh] Hrkt shrwrnhy chshmh w anchh r khh dr dlhy frd nhfth st, [bh khwby] m~dnd.
llh bh `dlt dwry m~knd; w m`bwdn~ kh [mshrkn] bh j~ llh `bdt mykhnnd, hych gwnh [Hq] dwry ndrnd. bh rsty khh llh shnwy bynst.

ay mshrkhn dr zmyn ngshthnd t bbynnd srnjmi khsny khh pysh z ann bwdnd, chgwnh bwdh st? an qwm gdhshth, nyrwmndtr z ynh bwdnd w athr w bnhy [stwrtr] byshtry dr zmyn pdyd awrdnd; m llh ann r bh [sbb] gnhnshn `dhb khrd, dr Hly khh dr brbri [`dhb] llh, hych [yr w] mdf`y ndshtnd.
yn [kyfr] bh sbb an bwd kh pymbrnshn nshnhh~ rwshn bryshn ry'h m~krdnd, wl~ ann nkr mywrzydnd w llh [nyz] ann r `dhb khrd. bygmn, w twnmnd~ skhtkyfr st.
m mws~ r b m`jzti khwd w dlyl~ qT` frstdym.
bh swy fr`wn w hmn w qrwn; wly [ann] gftnd: <<[w] jdwgry drwGgwst>>.

m hngmy khh mwsy, m`jzt lhy w dlyl mHkhm r z jnb m br ann ry'h krd, [fr`wn w yrnsh srkhshy khrdnd w] gftnd: <<psrn ksn~ r kh bh mws~ ymn awrdhnd, bkshyd w znnshn r [br~ khnyzy] zndh ngh dryd>>; w[l~] nyrng khfrn, mHkwm bh fnst.
fr`wn gft: <<bgdhryd mws~ r bkhshm; w [chwn ks~ r ndrd,] ngzyr st prwrdgrsh r bh yry bkhwnd [w mn z wy hrsy ndrm]. m~trsm khh w dyntn r dgrgwn szd y dr yn srzmyn tbh~ bh br awrd>>.
mwsy gft: <<mn z [shr] hr mtkhbry khh bh rwz Hsb bwr ndrd, bh prwrdgr khwysh w prwrdgr shm pnh mybrm>>.

w mrd mw'mny z khnwdhy fr`wn khh ymnsh r pnhn mydsht, gft: <<ay mykhwhyd yn mrd r [fqT bh yn jrm] bkhshyd khh mygwyd: "prwrdgrm llh st" w [dr t'yyd skhnsh nyz] dlyl rwshny z swy prwrdgrtn bry shm awrdh st? gr drwGgw bshd, [gnh] drwGsh br `hdhy khwdi wst; w gr rst gfth bshd, [dstkhm] brkh~ z `dhbhyy kh w`dh m~dhd, bh shm khwhd rsyd. bytrdyd, llh, khsy r khh srfkhr w drwGgwst, hdyt nmykhnd.

y qwm mn, mrwz frmnrwy~ dr khtyr shmst [w] dr yn srzmyn sulTh dryd; wl~ gr skhtgyr~i llh dmngyrmn shwd, chh ks~ m r yr~ khwhd krd?>> fr`wn gft: <<mn fqT anchh r SlH mydnm mygwym w shm r bh rh rst hdyt m~knm>>.
an mrd mw'mn gft: <<y qwm mn, mytrsm `dhby hmchwn `dhb qwm pyshyn [khh z pymbrnshn srpychy khrdnd] br srtn byyd;
mnnd shywhy [`dhb] qwm nwH w `d w thmwd w khsny khh b`d z ann bwdnd; dr Hly khh llh stmy bry bndgnsh nmykhwhd.
w y qwm mn, z rwzy br shm mytrsm khh mrdm bh fryd z ykhdygr yry mykhwhnd.
[hmn] rwz~ kh hmgy [z trs] bh `qb bzm~grdyd w dr brbr [mjzti] llh, hych mHfZ~ ndryd; w hr khs khh llh w r gmrh knd, hych hdytgry nkhwhd dsht.

pysh z yn nyz ywsf b dlyl rwshn nzdtn amd; m shm z anchh brytn awrdh bwd pywsth dr shkh bwdyd, t zmny khh z dny rft [w br trdydtn fzwdh shd]; angh gftyd: <<llh hrgz ps z wy pymbry r mb`wth nkhwhd khrd>>. llh, srfkhri bdgmn r yngwnh gmrh myszd.
